question: Which Linux companion app direction should become the canonical OpenClaw path now that Windows Hub is shipped?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow source fix: maintainers need to choose architecture, ownership, packaging, proof, and security review expectations before an implementation can safely land.

options.title: Make one Linux PR canonical
options.body: Pick the C/GTK4 or Rust/GTK4 track, require real desktop proof plus security/packaging review, and close or redirect the other implementation as a non-canonical alternative.

options.title: Split Linux into milestones
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and open narrower Linux milestones for setup, tray/status, notifications, node mode, packaging, and release docs before selecting an app PR.

options.title: Defer Linux app
options.body: Document that Linux remains Gateway-only for now and close or pause the open Linux companion PRs until a maintainer sponsors the platform work.

recommendation.title: Make one Linux PR canonical
recommendation.body: Pick the C/GTK4 or Rust/GTK4 track, require real desktop proof plus security/packaging review, and close or redirect the other implementation as a non-canonical alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, gave product direction in the thread, and owns the current platform-status wording in the checked-out history.
